title: Per-client rate limiter
requirement:
ratelimit.RateLimiter(limit, window_seconds, clock=time.monotonic).allow(client_id) currently always
returns True. Implement a sliding window: a client may make at most `limit` allowed requests in any
window of `window_seconds`; denied requests do not count. Clients are independent. Use the injected
clock so it can be tested.
acceptance_criteria: allowed again after the window passes
